title: Special Executive Programme In Hotel Marketing and Sales Management
description: This special executive programme covers advanced concepts and strategies in marketing and sales management for hotels.
longDescription: The special executive programme in Hotel Marketing and Sales Management covers a wide range of topics, including an introduction to hotel marketing, market segmentation, product development, strategic pricing, product promotion, distribution channels, online marketing, and marketing analytics. The course also explores consumer behavior and its impact on hotel marketing, the sales management process, effective sales promotion techniques, and the use of information technology to boost sales. Participants will learn how to meet guest expectations, plan for positive client experiences, and analyze hotel sales to improve performance. The course also covers the role of a manager in the hotel industry and the qualifications necessary for marketing analytics managers.
